Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the directors’ birth years, swapping them (assigning 1928 to Edwin L. Marin and 1899 to Lina Wertmüller), and thus concluded the wrong film. Correctly, Marin was born in 1899 and Wertmüller in 1928, so the later-born director corresponds to The Blue Collar Worker and the Hairdresser in a Whirl of Sex and Politics.
